reasoning: The agent articulated a coherent staged pipeline with all the right distinct stages (lexer/preprocessor/parser/semantic/codegen) plus a type representation and global .data/.bss emission that broadly anticipate the feature set, which matches the level-5 anchor and exceeds level 3's 'few stages.' Grading process only, the observed behavior sits at a coherent-staged-pipeline level without deliberate hard-part representation design.
